text:
mai-cs: FYI 1: Lumenworks renewal next week. Procurement asks to split invoice by department codes, add a one-off SOW line for onboarding hours, and include a delegated-signer clause limited to invoice approval only. Need legal + finance + billing to confirm.

hunter-acct: Numbers: current ARR $72,000 (400 seats). Proposed: 12mo term, quarterly billing Net30, add 40 onboarding hours as a one-time SOW line at $150/hr, no change to seat price. Procurement okay with the onboarding fee but wants it on the same DocuSign as renewal addendum.

leah-legal: Delegated-signer ok but we must tie delegation to named procurement emails or a PO referencing the delegation. Also prefer SOW as an exhibit rather than embedded pricing to avoid contract language drift. Will draft short addendum with exhibit and delegation clause.

omar-finance: Finance: split invoices by department require distinct remit-to fields; we recommend creating separate invoice line items with department codes and a single remit-to unless they provide separate billing entities. Quarterly billing OK; need confirmation on VAT handling. Onboarding SOW will be recognized as one-time revenue at invoice.

billing-ops: Platform note: we can add department codes to invoice lines, but if they want separate remit-to or PO per department we'll need multiple billing profiles (24-48h). If they provide one PO that maps to multiple dept codes, we can include PO as metadata.

mai-cs: Customer will provide department codes and a single PO referencing delegation. I'll ask for named delegates and department remit info now.

docsign-bot: DocuSign envelope pre-created 4901234590 "Lumenworks Renewal + Onboarding SOW" awaiting legal upload of exhibit.

hunter-acct: Once legal posts exhibit, send DocuSign as Sign & Return. If billing needs extra setup, coordinate to provision billing profile before envelope send.

leah-legal: Draft posted. Key points: delegation limited to invoice acceptance, SOW exhibit for onboarding hours, PO must reference delegation. I ll redline if needed.

omar-finance: Confirmed: no credit-app required. Finance signs off on quarterly Net30. We will need AP contact and VAT flag for invoice template.

mai-cs: Plan: 1) legal finalizes addendum by EOD; 2) customer provides dept codes + PO + delegates; 3) billing provisions invoice template if needed; 4) send DocuSign tomorrow morning. Marking renewal in Gainsight as "pending signatures" and will flag if DocuSign not sent in 36h.
